name: rl-architect
description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "activate the rl architect", "invoke the architect agent", "define the MDP", "formulate the RL problem", "design the state space", "design the reward function", "select the RL algorithm", or says "I need the architect to review the project". Orchestrates all theoretical design tasks for a reinforcement learning system from problem formulation to algorithm selection.
author: marconardelli
